description: SQLite connection and schema (better-auth tables + notes)
steps: src/lib/open-database.ts: openDatabase(file) creates the directory, sets pragmas journal_mode = WAL, foreign_keys = ON, busy_timeout
Idempotent schema: better-auth user, session, account, verification tables (SPEC §4)
notes table: id, user_id (FK ON DELETE CASCADE), title, content CHECK (json_valid(content)), share_token UNIQUE, shared_at, created_at, updated_at
Index idx_notes_user_updated ON notes(user_id, updated_at DESC)
src/lib/db.ts: single shared connection at DB_PATH, reused across dev hot reloads, in-memory during next build

description: Notes data-access layer with ownership checks (src/lib/notes-repo.ts)
steps: createNote(userId, input) in a transaction with the per-user cap (MAX_NOTES_PER_USER)
listNotes(userId) newest first by updated_at; getNote(userId, id)
updateNote(userId, id, input) sets updated_at; deleteNote(userId, id)
Every query filters WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?; missing and not-owned notes are indistinguishable
Validate id format before querying; prepared statements with bound params only

description: Public sharing in the data-access layer
steps: Share token from nanoid(32) (CSPRNG, never derived from ids or timestamps)
Turning sharing on issues a NEW token; staying shared keeps it; turning off sets share_token and shared_at to NULL
getSharedNote(token) validates token format first and selects only title, content, updated_at
emailAndPassword only, minPasswordLength 8, maxPasswordLength 128, autoSignIn false (no account enumeration on sign-up)
Session expiresIn 7 days, updateAge 1 day; cookies HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure in production
trustedOrigins = origin of BETTER_AUTH_URL only
Built-in in-memory rate limiter; 5/min on /sign-in/email and /sign-up/email
Before-hook validates and sanitizes name/email/image via src/lib/user-input.ts
nextCookies() plugin last; handler at src/app/api/auth/[...all]/route.ts
src/lib/env.ts validates BETTER_AUTH_SECRET (32+ chars), BETTER_AUTH_URL, DB_PATH
Production refuses to start when any is missing (src/instrumentation.ts); development uses local defaults; next build exempt
Error messages name variables only, never values
.env.example documents every variable
getSession() memoized per request via React cache + auth.api.getSession()
requireSession() redirects to /auth when signed out; called by every protected page and server action
getCurrentUser() returns only name and email to the UI

description: Auth page with sign-in and sign-up modes (/auth)
steps: src/app/auth/page.tsx with ?mode=sign-in|sign-up (parseAuthMode), /login and /register redirect to it
auth-form.tsx: name/email/password with native validation hints from auth-limits.ts
Generic error 'Invalid email or password.'; generic message for duplicate sign-up
Signed-in users are redirected to /dashboard; successful auth lands on /dashboard
src/components/site-header.tsx shows app name, signed-in user's name and Log out
signOutAction (src/app/auth/actions.ts) revokes the session and redirects to /auth
Server component protected by requireSession(), reads listNotes() directly
Each note links to /notes/[id] with title, local updated time and a 'Shared' badge
Empty state with a New Note call to action

description: TipTap editor restricted to the SPEC §10 allowlist
steps: src/lib/editor-extensions.ts: StarterKit with heading levels 1-3; blockquote, orderedList, strike, underline, link, hardBreak disabled
src/components/rich-text-editor.tsx serializes TipTap JSON into a hidden form field
src/components/editor-toolbar.tsx: undo/redo, paragraph, H1-H3, bold, italic, inline code, bullet list, code block, divider, with active states
src/lib/note-content.ts: zod .strict() allowlist of node/mark types plus the editor's ProseMirror schema check; 500 KB cap
src/app/notes/note-form-input.ts: title trimmed, NFC-normalized, 1-200 chars, no control or bidi characters; share checkbox is 'on' or absent
Invalid input returns field errors and echoes the submitted values
createNoteAction, updateNoteAction(id), deleteNoteAction(id) each call requireSession() first
User id always comes from the session, never from the form
Generic client errors; logs contain ids only, never title or content
Redirect to the note after save, to /dashboard after delete

description: Create, view, edit and delete note pages
steps: /notes/new and /notes/[id]/edit use the shared note-form.tsx (title, editor, 'Share publicly' checkbox)
/notes/[id] renders content read-only via note-renderer.tsx, shows last updated time, Edit and Delete
Delete asks for confirmation in a <dialog> before calling deleteNoteAction
Missing and not-owned notes return the same 404
Server-rendered, no login; shows only title, content and updated time
Unknown, malformed and revoked tokens return the same 404
Headers for /s/*: Referrer-Policy no-referrer, X-Robots-Tag noindex, nofollow, Cache-Control no-store; robots meta noindex
Owner's note page shows the public link with a copy button (copy-link-field.tsx)
vitest.config.mts: Node environment, tsconfig paths, server-only stubbed; pnpm test / pnpm test:watch
notes-repo: cross-user get/update/delete/share return not found; share/unshare/reshare token lifecycle
note-content and note-form-input: allowlist, oversize and malformed input rejected
actions (mocked session/repo), auth (real better-auth on in-memory DB), env, session, share-url
GET/POST src/app/api/notes/route.ts; GET/PATCH/DELETE src/app/api/notes/[id]/route.ts; export const runtime = 'nodejs'
No session → 401; missing or not-owned note → identical 404 body
zod .strict() bodies (title ≤ 200, content via parseNoteContent); body ≤ 1 MB → 413
All data access through src/lib/notes-repo.ts with the session user id
Vitest tests for every handler, including cross-user access
Add shareNote(userId, id) and unshareNote(userId, id) to notes-repo.ts (new token on every share, NULL on unshare)
POST returns { url } built with shareUrl(); DELETE returns 204
Owner-only with the same 401/404 rules as the notes API
Vitest tests: cross-user share/unshare → 404, old link 404 after unshare, reshare issues a new token

description: Origin check and per-user rate limit on mutating note routes
steps: POST/PATCH/DELETE under /api/notes reject a missing or mismatched Origin header with 403 (compare to BETTER_AUTH_URL origin)
In-memory per-user limiter, 60 mutations/min → 429 (single instance, SPEC §11.7)
Vitest tests for both
Edit page saves via PATCH /api/notes/:id with an 800 ms debounce after the last change, plus save on blur
Status indicator: Saving… / Saved / Error
No save on initial load; no overlapping requests (latest change wins)
Share on/off via the share endpoints instead of the form checkbox
Verify with Playwright MCP

description: Notes list route and home page
steps: /notes is currently a placeholder: show the notes list there (or redirect to /dashboard) per SPEC pages
/ is still 'Hello World': redirect signed-in users to /dashboard and show a short intro with sign-in/sign-up links otherwise
Verify with Playwright MCP

description: Rate limit the public share route per IP
steps: In-memory per-IP limiter for /s/[token] to slow token guessing (SPEC §11.3, §11.7)
Over the limit → 429 without querying the database
Vitest test for the limiter
Content-Security-Policy per SPEC (nonce-based script-src if Next.js needs it; read node_modules/next/dist/docs first)
X-Content-Type-Options nosniff, X-Frame-Options DENY, Referrer-Policy strict-origin-when-cross-origin (keep no-referrer on /s/*)
Strict-Transport-Security in production only; Permissions-Policy disabling camera, microphone, geolocation
Verify headers and that the editor still works under the CSP with Playwright MCP
Log failed sign-ins and 401/403/404-ownership denials with user id (if any), route, timestamp
Never log passwords, session tokens, share tokens or note content
Vitest test that sensitive values are not logged

description: Set up Playwright for E2E tests
steps: Add @playwright/test; playwright.config.ts with webServer running the app against a throwaway DB_PATH
e2e/ directory with sign-up/login helpers
Add pnpm test:e2e script and document it in CLAUDE.md
Sign up, log out, wrong password shows generic error, log in
Create note with formatting, edit title/content, delete with confirmation
Signed-out access to protected pages redirects to /auth
Register → create note → share → open public link signed out
Public page shows no user name or email
Stop sharing → old link returns 404; share again → new link works
Second user gets 404 on the first user's note
Multi-stage Dockerfile: pnpm build, next start, non-root user
SQLite file on a mounted volume (DB_PATH=/data/app.db), never under public/
Required env vars BETTER_AUTH_SECRET, BETTER_AUTH_URL, DB_PATH documented
Document daily backup with sqlite3 .backup or VACUUM INTO
